summary: Full Air OXLY backend API tested via public URL. 33/33 pytest tests passed covering auth, RBAC (super_admin/admin/sales isolation), products CRUD, users, customers (auto barcode OXLY-{n}, group scoping, sort options, lookup), transactions business logic (bayar>=total → hutang_transaksi=0 + prev_debt reduced by overflow; bayar<total → hutang_transaksi = total-bayar added to new_debt; gallon_loans += pinjam - kembali; customer state updates; sales edit 1x then 400; admin cannot edit; super delete reverses state), reports/daily aggregation by sales_code with group scoping, location ping/live/history RBAC, and stats/overview.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') hooks – consider migrating to lifespan context manager (not blocking; still works).
In create_transaction, body.bayar is not validated as >=0; a negative bayar would inflate hutang_transaksi. Minor edge-case; not currently required.

list_customers uses filt['group_letter'] for admin AND sales but a super_admin has no filter – matches spec but note total_debt/gallon_loans/last_purchase_date sort may put nulls unexpectedly (acceptable).
next_customer_no() only inspects last customer_no; if a customer is manually inserted with lower no it still works, but no gap-fill (fine).
seed_data_creation: Test-created TEST_ prefixed customers, users, and products were created. Admin-created test sales user was deleted; test product was deleted. TEST_ customers/txns remain in DB (harmless for functional testing).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_oxly_backend.py – reusable regression. Uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from env. All roles/flows exercised. Frontend was not tested per request.
